objective: USINE run 'u-l2-gas' of cr-propagation D3 (level2): translated from a transport block by usine_translate.py, then the D3 settings of d3_study.py applied

extension.input_manifest_note: sha256 is of each file as run, with the absolute paths of the run directory and of USINE's inputs folder written into usine.init.par; committed_form_sha256 is of the same file written with the placeholders <TOOL_HOME>/inputs and <RUN_DIR> (the form committed under tests/adapters/fixtures/cr_propagation/usine/inputs/), equal to sha256 for the files that hold no path; entries with read_in_place are USINE's own files (GPL-2.0), hashed where they lie and never copied

tools.name: USINE
tools.version: V3.5 (git tag V3.5, commit fb53006db41d1a640bf1b5af1a4b0f899ca59673; built with Apple clang 21.0.0 against ROOT 6.38.04)

seeds.note: USINE's local-flux calculation is deterministic: no random numbers are drawn

tolerances.note: USINE EPS_ITERCONV 1e-6, EPS_INTEGR 1e-4, EPS_NORMDATA 1e-10 (written into the initialisation file); outputs printed with 6 significant digits

extension.exit_status_note: exit_status is the run's outcome as judged by usine_translate.py (0: every expected output written, no USINE error or crash in the log); USINE V3.5 itself returns 1 on every path (usine_exit_status)
notes: observer at r = 8.3 kpc, z = 0 (not fixed by the transport block); no central hole
diffusion.form 'beta^eta (R/R0)^delta with smooth breaks': not parsed; K = beta^eta K0 (Rig/R0)^delta times the break factors is fixed by the canonical fields
reacceleration off (V_A = 0): zone 'thin-disc', relation 'Seo-Ptuskin 1994' not used
decay off: lorentz_dilation True, ec_treatment 'fully-stripped' not used

cross_sections.ghost_threshold 'off: ghost nuclei and tertiary chains off (IsLoadGhosts false)': not parsed; ghost nuclei are not loaded (IsLoadGhosts false; the cumulative cross sections of USINE's chart crcharts_Zmax30_ghost97.dat) and tertiary chains are off
sources.injection species_group ['all primaries']: one slope for every primary of the network
sources.spatial 'not fixed by harmonized-v1; each code records its choice': not parsed; uniform in r up to radius_kpc in the thin disc (template CST)

gas 'n_H = 1.089763419 cm^-3 (DRAGON2 BronfFerr nucleon column at the observer / 2 h)': HI = 1.08976, HII = 0, H2 = 0 cm^-3, He = He_to_H_number x (HI + HII + 2 H2) = 0.119874 cm^-3 in the thin disc; targets H, He
cross sections: USINE's own files XS_NUCLEI/sigProdGALPROP17_OPT12.dat (production) and XS_NUCLEI/sigInelTripathi99+Coste12.dat (inelastic), read in place from HEP_USINE_DATA (GPL-2.0, never copied)
source spectrum dQ/dE_k/n = q Rig^-2.3 (USINE POWERLAW, eta_s = 0), uniform in r up to radius_kpc in the thin disc (template CST)

source abundances: solar-system isotopic fractions and abundances with the FIP bias (USINE kSSISOTFRAC, kSSISOTABUND, kFIPBIAS, solarsystem_abundances2003.dat), then each element normalised to data of USINE's crdata_crdb20170523.dat: H,He to PAMELA at 20 GeV/n; C,N,O to HEAO at 10.6 GeV/n; pure secondaries Li,Be,B
network: every nucleus of USINE's chart crcharts_Zmax30_ghost97.dat from 1H to 16O; no antinuclei; tertiary chains, ghost nuclei and exotic primaries off
family 'SLIM': a label of the model family, not read by the translator
free []: one run fixes every parameter; a fit varies the free ones
not given in the transport block, the translator's value used: geometry.local_bubble_radius_kpc = 0.0 kpc (no local bubble)
D3 run kind level2, config isotopic
